notes:
Sixth release candidate for 2.2.0, for playtesting. Foundry v14, PF2e or SF2e.

Everything in rc.5, plus one important fix.

Power automation and token frames now run

Since 2.1.0, two of the module's scripts crashed as Foundry loaded them, with Identifier 'MODULE_ID' has already been declared in the console. That meant none of the following ran:

  • Power automation: save buttons applying damage and conditions, NPC Biotics and NPC Tech, area damage, barrier drain, Charge/Nova barrier effects, and the mastery adjustments.
  • Token frames: framing tokens with Tokenizer 2 on first drop.

Both now load correctly. If powers seemed to do nothing in earlier playtests, this was why.

Please test

1. Reload Foundry and open the console (F12): there should be no MODULE_ID errors. 2. Have an NPC use Overload or Warp on a PC and click the save button on the card: the damage and conditions should apply. 3. With Tokenizer 2 installed, drag a fresh actor onto a scene: its token should get a frame. 4. Rerun anything from earlier test checklists that involved powers.
